test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement regarding ocean currents is correct?

options.text: The Labrador Ocean current is warm current.
The areas where the warm and cold currents meet provide the best fishing grounds.
The cold ocean currents move towards the poles.
The warm ocean currents move towards the equator.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The areas where the warm and cold currents meet provide the best fishing grounds.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ocean currents are streams of water flowing constantly on the ocean surface in definite directions.
 
• The ocean currents may be warm or cold.
 
• Generally, the warm currents originate near the equator and move toward the poles.
 
• The cold currents carry water from polar or higher latitudes to tropical or lower latitudes. 
 
• The Ocean current influences the temperature conditions of the area.
 
• **The areas where the warm and cold currents meet provide the best fishing grounds of the world.**
 
• Seas around Japan and the eastern coast of North America are such examples.
